title: Use AGENTS.md for managed agent instructions
body:
## Summary

Use `AGENTS.md` as the single instruction file across Next.js agent tooling. `next dev`, `create-next-app`, upgrades, the legacy docs-index codemod, and eval fixtures no longer create, discover, or update `CLAUDE.md`.

This also removes the repository's compatibility symlink and updates the documentation and tests around generated agent instructions. Claude Code now reads `AGENTS.md` directly, so the additional alias is no longer needed.

## Verification

- 10 managed-file unit tests pass.
- 12 dev-server integration tests pass, including `agentRules: false` with agent feedback enabled.
- 12 `agents-md` codemod tests pass.
- 2 focused `create-next-app` tests pass for `--agents-md` and `--no-agents-md`.
- The `next`, `create-next-app`, and `@next/codemod` package builds pass.
- Focused ESLint passes.
- Full `pnpm build-all` remains blocked by Cargo workspace inheritance for `turbo-persistence` (`default-features`). Root `pnpm typescript` fails in the unchanged `evals/next-upgrade/lib/experiment.ts` setup callback.

<!-- NEXT_JS_LLM -->
